palette.primary_role: Header bg, footer bg, primary trust color (forest/earth green for hope and nature)
palette.accent_role: Donate buttons (warm terracotta/orange), impact stats highlights, urgent call-to-action markers
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (warm cream/off-white), story sections, program highlights
palette.neutral_role: Body text, secondary information, captions, footer links
palette.border_role: Card borders, input borders, dividers (soft, warm grays, not cold)

button_styles.text: Donate Now, Give Monthly, Support Our Mission, Help Today
Learn More, See Our Impact, Get Involved, Volunteer
Join Us, Become a Volunteer, Partner With Us

elevation.approach: Gentle shadows that feel organic and approachable. Not corporate — feels like a community space.

typical_order: header (light bg, logo left, nav center, 'Donate' CTA button right — warm, not corporate)
hero (full-width mission photo or video + headline + subtitle + primary Donate CTA + secondary Learn More)
impact_stats (counter animation row: lives impacted, projects completed, countries served, volunteers mobilized — with icons)
programs (3-column grid: program photo + title + short description + 'Learn more' link)
stories (individual impact stories: beneficiary photo + quote + name + program, alternating left/right layout)
donate_cta (centered, warm bg, suggested amounts ($25/$50/$100/$250) + 'Other' input + monthly toggle)
volunteer (photo-rich section: ways to get involved, event calendar, signup form)
footer (4-column: mission statement, programs, get involved, contact/donate + tax ID + transparency links)
hero_variants: mission_statement (charity: water style — bold mission text over beautiful human-centered photo, warm overlay)
urgent_appeal (Red Cross style — impactful photo, urgent headline, prominent donate button, crisis context)
nature_immersive (WWF style — stunning wildlife/landscape photo, minimal text, emotional connection first)
community_photo (Habitat for Humanity style — volunteers + beneficiaries together, warm, human, relational)
feature_card_variants: impact_stat_card (large number + label + icon, counter animation, accent top stripe)
program_card (photo + program name + description + 'Support this program' link, equal height grid)
story_card (beneficiary photo + quote + name + location, editorial feel, human-centered)
donation_tier_card (amount + impact description: '$25 provides clean water for one person', clickable, border highlight on hover)

tone_profile.headline_style: emotionally resonant, under 8 words (e.g., 'Clean Water for Every Person.', 'Hope Heals. You Make It Possible.')
tone_profile.cta_style: values-driven action verbs (Donate, Give, Join, Support, Help, Make a Difference, Change a Life)

color_mood: forest_hope (#2d6a4f green, #fefae0 cream, #e07a5f terracotta — balanced, nature-connected, warm)
ocean_compassion (Blues: #1d3557 navy, #457b9d blue, #f1faee white, #e63946 red accent for urgency)
earth_nurture (#606c38 olive, #fefae0 parchment, #bc6c25 copper, #283618 dark moss — grounded, organic)
sunrise_optimism (#f4a261 warm orange, #ffffff, #264653 dark teal, #e9c46a yellow — bright, hopeful, energetic)
sage_calm (#8cb369 sage green, #f5f0e8 warm white, #bc4b51 muted red, #f4e285 soft gold — gentle, peaceful)
typography_mood: merriweather_classic (Merriweather headings, Nunito body — trustworthy, editorial, established NGOs)
lora_warm (Lora headings, Source Sans 3 body — warm, approachable, community organizations)
libre_statement (Libre Baskerville headings, Inter body — authoritative, foundation/advocacy feel)
layout_density: story_driven (large photos, narrative flow, immersive storytelling — charity: water style)
impact_dashboard (stats-forward, data visualization, transparency-focused — GiveDirectly style)
community_hub (event calendar, volunteer signups, social feed — local community organizations)

donation_page.best_practices: Suggested giving levels with impact descriptions, monthly/one-time toggle, minimal form fields, transparent fee disclosure, donor wall option
